_metadata.artifact_kind_note: This is a hand-authored seed artifact. The pulls[] array is intentionally empty because the analysis sandbox has no network access to the GitHub API. The observed_merge_commits_on_main[] sub-object provides the authoritative local-git fallback data extracted via 'git log main --merges --pretty=format:%H|%aI|%s'. When scripts/03_extract_pulls.py runs with GH_TOKEN set and network reachable, it will overwrite this file with the populated PR inventory; the run_id and extraction_timestamp will then reflect that execution.

github_api.endpoint_note: The 'state=all' parameter is REQUIRED. Per AAP §0.2.2 web-search insight, the GitHub Pulls API defaults to returning only open PRs; closed AND merged PRs MUST be retrieved for Flow Velocity (M2) and Flow Time (M7). Without state=all, both metrics would silently report zero.
github_api.supplementary_endpoints_note: Per AAP §0.2.1.2 these auxiliary endpoints are also consumed by scripts/03_extract_pulls.py to populate pr_commits_first_at_iso/pr_commits_last_at_iso (used by M4 Flow Active and M7 Flow Time), review-event timestamps (used by M4 ready-for-review bounding), and PR event timeline (used by M4 ready-for-review event detection). Their raw outputs are persisted to data/reviews.json and data/pull_events.json respectively.
github_api.unavailable_reason: GH_TOKEN environment variable not set or rate limit exceeded; analysis sandbox has no outbound network access for this seed run
github_api.fallback_note: When the API is unreachable, scripts/03_extract_pulls.py reconstructs PRs from merge commits on main: parse merge-commit subjects for 'Merge pull request #NN' patterns, walk the merge commit's parent branches to identify the first-commit-on-branch. This local-git fallback gives a lower bound on merged-PR count and cannot resolve PR-level fields that exist only on the GitHub side (draft state, labels, requested_reviewers, body, classified_category from PR title). The observed_merge_commits_on_main array below records the local-git fallback inventory; the empty pulls[] array indicates that no API-derived PR objects were available.

excluded_authors_note: Per AAP §0.5.3.3 Flow Velocity, dependency-bot authors are excluded. The single excluded entry is the dependabot[bot] GitHub App account whose presence is confirmed via .github/dependabot.yml (which declares the gomod, github-actions, and docker package-ecosystems Dependabot manages in this repository). Blitzy actors are NOT excluded: agent@blitzy.com is the canonical Blitzy engineering identity (included in Flow Velocity as the after-period engineering actor per AAP §0.5.3.3); 191547922+blitzy[bot]@users.noreply.github.com is the GitHub App auto-merge identity (included to the extent its PR-authoring activity represents engineering output by Blitzy per AAP §0.1.5).

excluded_authors_emails_verification.decision: Only dependabot[bot] is added to excluded_authors. blitzy[bot] is intentionally NOT excluded per AAP §0.1.5 (Blitzy carve-out).

blitzy_actor_emails_note: The canonical Blitzy engineering-actor identity is the union of agent@blitzy.com (primary, used by 512 of 538 commits) and 191547922+blitzy[bot]@users.noreply.github.com (auto-merge App identity, used by 5 of 538 commits). Per AAP §0.1.5, both are treated as the single 'Blitzy' row in any per-actor aggregation (Metrics 2, 4, 5, 6, 10). Verified via git log --all --pretty=format:%aE | sort -u against the 538-commit roster in data/commits.csv.
pulls_note: Hand-authored seed: empty array. When scripts/03_extract_pulls.py runs with a reachable GitHub API, this array will be populated with one object per PR (open + closed + merged) matching the Per-PR Schema documented in the file header of this artifact and in the AAP §'Per-PR Schema' block. Per-PR fields include: number, state, title, body, draft, created_at, updated_at, closed_at, merged_at, merge_commit_sha, user (login, id, type, email), head (ref, sha, repo_full_name), base (ref, sha, repo_full_name), labels, requested_reviewers, requested_teams, linked_linear_keys (extracted from title+body via regex '[A-Z]{2,}-\d+' per the PR template's Linear ticket reference), pr_commits_first_at_iso, pr_commits_last_at_iso, pr_commits_count, is_dependency_bot, is_blitzy_actor, head_ref_is_blitzy_prefix, classified_category (one of: feature, defect, risk_compliance, tech_debt, unknown), classified_category_source (one of: linear_label, conventional_commit_prefix, keyword_match, default_unknown), phase (one of: baseline, post_introduction, outside_window).

per_pr_schema_documentation.schema_note: This block documents the per-PR object schema for downstream consumers (scripts/09_compute_metrics.py). When pulls[] is populated, every object MUST conform to this schema.

field_types.title: string
field_types.user: object { login: string, id: integer, type: 'User'|'Bot', email: string|null }
field_types.head: object { ref: string, sha: string, repo_full_name: string }
field_types.base: object { ref: string, sha: string, repo_full_name: string }
field_types.requested_reviewers: array of object { login: string, id: integer }
field_types.requested_teams: array of object { name: string, slug: string }
field_types.linked_linear_keys: array of string keys matching regex '[A-Z]{2,}-\d+'
field_types.classified_category: string enum: feature | defect | risk_compliance | tech_debt | unknown
field_types.classified_category_source: string enum: linear_label | conventional_commit_prefix | keyword_match | default_unknown

classification_priority_per_AAP_0_5_3_7: 1. linear_label: if PR body or title contains a Linear ticket key [A-Z]{2,}-\d+ AND LINEAR_API_KEY is set, fetch the linked Linear issue's labels and apply user-defined rules.

2. conventional_commit_prefix: parse PR title for leading type per .github/workflows/semantic-pr.yaml: feat → feature, fix → defect, chore → tech_debt, refactor → tech_debt, exp → tech_debt, doc → tech_debt, test → tech_debt.

3. keyword_match: scan title+body for tokens: security|compliance|audit|sla|gdpr|pci|cve|vulnerability → risk_compliance; bug|fix|regression|hotfix → defect; refactor|tech debt|cleanup|rename|format → tech_debt; feature|add|support|enable → feature.
4. default_unknown: when none of the above resolve.
per_pr_schema_documentation.phase_assignment_rule: phase=baseline if created_at < inflection_date_utc; phase=post_introduction if created_at >= inflection_date_utc AND created_at <= analysis_period_end; phase=outside_window otherwise.

observed_merge_commits_on_main.merge_subject: merge: integrate main branch with SDK compatibility features (Sprint 2-3)
observed_merge_commits_on_main.note: Ad-hoc merge without PR number reference. The committer timestamp 2026-03-27T03:42:16Z is the UTC equivalent of the local-timezone form 2026-03-26T23:42:16-04:00 emitted by git log %aI.

observed_merge_commits_on_main_note: Authoritative count of explicit merge commits on main, extracted via 'git log main --merges --pretty=format:%H|%aI|%s'. Five of the six reference a numbered PR (#11, #12, #18, #20, #27); the sixth is an ad-hoc local merge without a PR number reference. IMPORTANT: this count is NOT equivalent to the count of merged PRs. Squash-merged PRs (the default in GitHub for many workflows) do NOT appear as merge commits at all — they appear as single commits with their original subject preserved. The local-git fallback therefore provides a LOWER BOUND on the merged-PR count: at least 5 numbered PRs were merged via the explicit-merge-commit path. The exact merged-PR count requires GitHub Pulls API access; without it, M2 (Flow Velocity) and M7 (Flow Time) report Medium confidence with this caveat surfaced in the report's Risk Assessment.

observed_merge_commits_on_main_phase_dis.note: All 6 merge commits fall after the inflection point 2026-02-25T02:58:59Z. The baseline phase (2026-02-23T05:19:38Z to inflection) contained only a single commit on main and zero merge commits.

summary.summary_note: All counts are zero because this is a hand-authored seed with an empty pulls[] array. The observed_merge_commits_on_main array above provides the local-git fallback signal. When scripts/03_extract_pulls.py runs with API access, this summary block will be repopulated from the populated pulls[] array.
summary.prs_per_2week_window_baseline_note: Baseline phase spans only 2026-02-23 → 2026-02-25 (≈ 2 days). No full 2-week window fits in this range, so the per-window array is empty by definition. Per AAP §0.5.3.4 Flow Predictability, fewer than 4 windows triggers 'Insufficient signal — fewer than 4 windows' for M3 in the baseline phase.
summary.prs_per_2week_window_post_introduction_n: Post-introduction phase spans 2026-02-25 → 2026-05-21 (≈ 86 days, ≈ 6 two-week windows). When the API is reached, this array will have approximately 6 entries, each of the form { window_start_iso, window_end_iso, merged_prs_count, prs_in_progress_at_window_end_count, draft_prs_at_window_end_count }.

rule_compliance.rule_1_data_provenance: Every numeric value in this artifact is derived from a single named extraction command. The observed_merge_commits_on_main array is the output of 'git log main --merges --pretty=format:%H|%aI|%s'. The blitzy_actor_emails and excluded_authors lists are derived from 'git log --all --pretty=format:%aE | sort -u'. The empty pulls[] array reflects the github_api.available=false state. No estimation, extrapolation, or fabrication.
rule_compliance.rule_3_confidence_transparency: When this artifact's pulls[] array is empty (current state), downstream metrics M1/M2/M4/M5/M6/M7 fall back to local-git signals with confidence downgraded per AAP §0.2.4. The downstream metrics.json renderer surfaces this in the report's Risk Assessment section.
rule_compliance.rule_4_internal_consistency: _metadata.inflection_date_utc=2026-02-25T02:58:59Z is identical to data/inflection.json#date_utc. _metadata.run_id=ff490c72-43fb-4c05-b466-b9355cab917f is identical to the run_id in data/environment.json and data/inflection.json (single-run correlation per the Observability rule).
rule_compliance.rule_5_reproducibility: The exact endpoint string in github_api.endpoint plus the fallback method in github_api.fallback_note together specify how to re-derive this artifact from scratch. The Reproducibility Appendix in acceleration-report.md will reference both.
rule_compliance.rule_6_environment_first: _metadata fields satisfy the Environment Verification preamble: repository_slug, default_branch, analysis_period_start, analysis_period_end, inflection_date_utc, extraction_timestamp, run_id. Cross-referenced with data/environment.json.
